name: fast-ios-device-test
description: Fast iOS verification for Claude Code: /fastSimulatorTest drives Simulator UI flows, including iPhone Duo outer/inner displays, closed/open/book/tabletop poses and per-pose recordings, plus per-simulator fan-out, system and prebuilt apps. /fastDeviceTest runs the same flows on a physical iPhone and records its screen; fastUIMap prints the screen map earlier runs recorded; /fastUIReview reviews every recorded case; passing runs are filed as captioned PR evidence.
